summary_en: Channel management, pricing, guest comms and cleaning for STR portfolios.
summary_fr: Channel manager, pricing, relation voyageur et ménage pour la courte durée.

tools.name: Amenitiz
tools.positioning: An all-in-one property management system for independent hospitality — the small hotel, the gîte, the chambre d'hôtes.
tools.description: Amenitiz combines a property management system, a website builder with a direct booking engine, a channel manager, payment processing and revenue tools, aimed at independent accommodation providers rather than at professional rental managers.
tools.real_estate_use: The independent French hospitality operator — a guesthouse, a small hotel, a set of gîtes — typically has no website of its own and depends entirely on commissioned platforms. Amenitiz packages the site, the booking engine and the channel connections in one subscription, which is why it reaches operators who would never buy three separate tools.
features: Property management system for small accommodation
Website builder with direct booking engine
Channel manager across major booking platforms
Payment processing and deposit handling
Rate and availability management
Guest communication and review handling

use_cases.job: Get a bookable website and channel connections without assembling a stack
Manage rates and availability for a small property across every channel

tools.name: Arkiane
tools.positioning: Logiciel Windows de gestion de location saisonnière et transaction pour agences immobilières, avec comptabilité mandante intégrée depuis Grenoble.
tools.description: Arkiane Power Locations Vacances is a French Windows-based management software for real estate agencies specialized in seasonal rentals, covering booking and pricing management, integrated trust accounting validated by the Galian and Socaf guarantee funds, digital check-in/check-out inventories, multi-channel distribution and multi-site, multi-accountant setups for networks of offices. The company also publishes a real estate transaction module and merged with fellow French vendor Enova into the Octrolis group in 2021.
tools.description_fr: Arkiane Power Locations Vacances est un logiciel français sous Windows de gestion de la location saisonnière et de la transaction pour les agences immobilières, couvrant la gestion des réservations et des tarifs, une comptabilité mandante intégrée validée par les caisses de garantie Galian et Socaf, les états des lieux numériques, la multidiffusion des annonces et une gestion multi-site et multi-comptable pour les réseaux d'agences. L'éditeur publie aussi un module de transaction immobilière, et a fusionné avec le français Enova au sein du groupe Octrolis en 2021.
tools.real_estate_use: A seasonal-rental agency running several offices needs its bookings, pricing by tour-operator rate and trust accounting to stay consistent across sites and accountants, and its guarantee-fund auditors (Galian, Socaf) to be able to check that accounting directly. Arkiane runs the booking calendar, generates digital inventories and contracts, and keeps the mandant accounting in a form the guarantee funds already validate.
features: Seasonal booking and nightly-rate management by tour operator
Trust (mandante) accounting validated by Galian and Socaf guarantee funds
Digital check-in and check-out inventories
Multi-channel booking distribution
Multi-site, multi-accountant management for agency networks

use_cases.job: Run seasonal-rental bookings and tour-operator pricing across several agency offices
Keep mandant accounting in a form the Galian/Socaf guarantee funds can audit directly

tools.name: Breezeway
tools.positioning: Property operations and guest experience platform for the teams cleaning, inspecting and servicing short-term rentals.
tools.description: Breezeway coordinates the field work behind a short-term rental portfolio rather than the booking side. It schedules cleaning and maintenance tasks, dispatches them to cleaners and vendors through a mobile app with photo checklists, tracks inventory and supplies, pays cleaners, and reports on what was done. A second product line handles guest communication: messaging, digital welcome books, an AI assistant answering guest questions, and paid upsells. A freemium tier covers a single property.
tools.real_estate_use: A vacation rental manager with a scattered portfolio and a mix of employed and subcontracted cleaners has the same problem every turnover day: knowing that each property was actually cleaned, inspected and restocked before the next guest arrives. Breezeway turns each departure into a scheduled task with a photo checklist the cleaner completes on their phone, so the manager sees evidence rather than a claim, and damage or a missing item surfaces as a work order before the guest does. Pricing is per property, which is why managers of five homes and of five hundred both use it, and residential and corporate housing operators use the same operations layer.
features: Task scheduling and work coordination across field teams
Mobile checklists with photo capture, available in several languages
Work order and preventive maintenance management
Inventory and supply tracking
Cleaner and vendor payments
Guest messaging with digital guidebooks, AI answering and paid upsells

use_cases.job: Prove every turnover was cleaned and inspected before the next check-in
Turn a defect spotted during a clean into a dispatched work order

sources.note: site éditeur — accueil et carte des produits

tools.name: Guesty
tools.positioning: The property management system for professional short-term rental operators, built around the channel.
tools.description: Guesty is a short-term and vacation rental management platform: channel management across Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and others, unified inbox, automated guest messaging, direct booking websites, payments, cleaning and task automation, and revenue tools.
tools.real_estate_use: A manager running two hundred apartments across four booking platforms faces a double-booking risk on every listing and a message volume no team can answer manually. Guesty synchronises availability and rates across channels, automates the guest message sequence from booking to checkout, and triggers the cleaning task the moment a stay ends.
features: Multi-channel synchronisation of availability, rates and reservations
Unified guest inbox with automated messaging sequences
Direct booking website and payment processing
Cleaning and maintenance task automation per turnover
Revenue management and dynamic pricing integrations
Owner reporting and statements for managed properties

use_cases.job: Run hundreds of listings across four booking channels without double bookings
Receive owner statements on short-term rental income from a manager

tools.name: HomeFlow
tools.positioning: Plateforme tout-en-un pour conciergeries : channel manager, planning de ménage, paiements et messagerie IA, sans commission sur les réservations.
tools.description: HomeFlow is a French all-in-one management platform for short-term rental concierge operators, combining a multi-platform channel manager, a booking and cleaning-task planner, guest and owner payments through Stripe, a digital guidebook and a unified team/guest messaging inbox with AI-generated replies and translation, priced per property per month with no commission on bookings.
tools.description_fr: HomeFlow est une plateforme française tout-en-un pour les conciergeries de location courte durée. Elle réunit un channel manager multi-plateforme, un planificateur de réservations et de ménages, les paiements voyageurs et propriétaires via Stripe, un livret d'accueil numérique et une messagerie unifiée équipe/voyageurs avec réponses générées par IA et traduction, facturée par bien et par mois, sans commission sur les réservations.
tools.real_estate_use: A concierge company running dozens of listings across Airbnb, Booking.com and other OTAs needs one calendar that prevents double-bookings, one place to assign and track cleaning after each checkout, and one inbox for guest messages instead of switching between ten separate tools and platform apps. HomeFlow synchronizes the channels, auto-generates cleaning tasks from bookings, and lets the team and the property owner each see their own view of the same operation.
features: Multi-platform channel manager with real-time sync across 40+ OTAs
Visual multi-property booking and pricing planner
Automated cleaning and maintenance task scheduling with checklists
Stripe-based guest payments and pre-authorized deposits
Unified team and guest messaging with AI auto-replies and translation
Owner and field-team mobile apps

use_cases.job: Run bookings, pricing and cleaning across dozens of short-term rental listings from one calendar
See their own properties' planning and revenue from a dedicated owner app

capabilities: Réponses automatiques et traduction dans la messagerie unifiée équipe/voyageurs

tools.name: Hostaway
tools.positioning: Channel management and automation for growing STR portfolios, with an open marketplace rather than a closed suite.
tools.description: Hostaway provides short-term rental channel management, a unified inbox, automated messaging and task workflows, direct booking sites, payment processing and reporting, with an integration marketplace covering pricing, locks, cleaning and accounting tools.
tools.real_estate_use: Its typical buyer is a manager scaling from twenty to two hundred units who wants to keep their existing pricing and cleaning tools. The open integration approach means the operator assembles a stack — Hostaway for channels and automation, PriceLabs for rates, Turno for cleaning — rather than accepting one vendor's version of each.
features: Channel management across major booking platforms
Automation rules for messaging, pricing and tasks
Unified inbox across channels
Direct booking website with payment processing
Owner statements and portfolio reporting
Open integration marketplace and API

use_cases.job: Scale a short-term rental portfolio while keeping best-of-breed pricing and cleaning tools
Automate the full guest message sequence across every channel

tools.name: Icnea
tools.positioning: All-in-one PMS and channel manager for vacation rental agencies, expanded from Spain into France, Italy, Portugal and beyond.
tools.description: Icnea is a Spanish (Barcelona) publisher of an all-in-one property management system and channel manager for vacation rental agencies, founded in 2001. It covers bookings, properties, owners and administration in one dashboard, connects to more than 150 booking channels, and includes revenue management, an owner extranet and newsletter/marketing tools. It states having expanded its market to Spain, Portugal, Italy, France, Mexico and Dubai.
tools.real_estate_use: A vacation-rental management agency running a portfolio of properties across many booking channels needs bookings, pricing and owner reporting to stay consistent everywhere at once. Icnea centralises reservations, property and owner records, and channel synchronisation in one PMS, with statistics segmented by property, region, owner or channel so an agency can report back to each property owner without manual reconciliation.
features: All-in-one dashboard for bookings, properties, owners and administration
Channel manager connecting to 150+ booking channels
Revenue and pricing management
Owner extranet with statistics by property, region, owner and channel
Newsletter and marketing campaign tools
Vacation-rental website builder

use_cases.job: Centralise bookings, pricing and owner reporting for a portfolio of vacation rental properties across many channels

tools.name: Lodgify
tools.positioning: A vacation rental website and booking engine first, with channel management attached.
tools.description: Lodgify provides vacation rental owners and small managers with a website builder and direct booking engine, channel manager synchronising with major platforms, reservation and calendar management, payment processing and automated guest messaging.
tools.real_estate_use: For an owner with two or three holiday properties, the practical question is whether to pay fifteen percent commission forever. Lodgify's proposition is a bookable site they own, with the channels kept as a fill mechanism — a different emphasis from the professional systems, which assume channels are the primary demand source.
features: Website builder with direct booking engine
Channel manager across major booking platforms
Calendar, rate and reservation management
Payment processing and damage deposits
Automated guest messaging and templates
Owner and property performance reporting

use_cases.job: Take direct bookings on an owned site instead of paying commission on every stay
Synchronise calendars across platforms for a small set of properties

tools.name: Loftely
tools.positioning: Logiciel français de gestion de conciergerie et location courte durée : réservations, ménages, facturation propriétaire, hébergé en France.
tools.description: Loftely is a French management platform for short-term rental concierge companies, centralizing bookings synced across platforms via iCal, automated cleaning and maintenance task scheduling triggered by each reservation, owner invoicing and a dedicated owner portal, and multilingual digital guidebooks, priced per active property per month with the first property free.
tools.description_fr: Loftely est une plateforme française de gestion pour les conciergeries de location courte durée, qui centralise les réservations synchronisées entre plateformes via iCal, la planification automatique des tâches de ménage et d'entretien déclenchées par chaque réservation, la facturation propriétaire avec un espace dédié, et des livrets d'accueil multilingues, facturée par logement actif et par mois avec le premier logement gratuit.
tools.real_estate_use: A concierge company managing a portfolio of seasonal rentals needs bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com and other channels to land in one calendar, each new reservation to automatically create its cleaning and check-in tasks for the field team, and the resulting activity to flow into the property owner's monthly invoice and portal — instead of reconciling separate booking, task and billing tools by hand.
features: Two-way iCal synchronization across booking platforms into one calendar
Automated task creation for cleaning, check-in and check-out per booking
Owner invoicing and a self-service owner portal
Multilingual digital guidebooks for guests
Mobile app for field agents

use_cases.job: Turn each new booking into scheduled cleaning and check-in tasks automatically
Track their own properties' bookings and invoices from a dedicated owner space

pricing.unit: par logement actif par mois, HT

tools.name: OwnerRez
tools.positioning: The vacation rental system for owners who care about the contract, the insurance and the tax more than the design.
tools.description: OwnerRez covers vacation rental management: channel management, bookings and quotes, renter agreements with e-signature, damage protection and insurance options, automated messaging, payment processing, and detailed accounting and tax reporting.
tools.real_estate_use: Its distinguishing depth is legal and financial rather than marketing. Renter agreements are signed per booking, damage protection is attached, and lodging tax is calculated by jurisdiction — a real problem in the US, where a short-term rental can owe state, county and city tax at different rates on the same stay.
features: Channel management with major booking platforms
Renter agreements with electronic signature per booking
Damage protection and travel insurance options
Lodging tax calculation by jurisdiction
Automated guest messaging and triggers
Detailed accounting, owner statements and reporting

use_cases.job: Attach a signed rental agreement and the right lodging taxes to every booking
Produce owner statements and tax reporting for managed vacation properties

tools.name: PriceLabs
tools.positioning: Dynamic pricing for short-term rentals, with the reasoning visible instead of hidden in a black box.
tools.description: PriceLabs sets nightly rates for short-term rental listings using market demand data, seasonality, day-of-week patterns and booking pace, with customisable rules, minimum-stay optimisation and a market dashboard covering comparable listings.
tools.real_estate_use: Nightly pricing is the single biggest lever on STR revenue and the one humans handle worst — most hosts set a rate and forget it. PriceLabs adjusts every listing daily against local demand, and its market dashboard is widely used before acquisition, to check what comparable properties in a neighbourhood actually earn across a year.
features: Dynamic nightly pricing driven by market demand signals
Customisable rules, floors, ceilings and seasonal overrides
Minimum-stay and gap-night optimisation
Market dashboards with comparable listing performance
Portfolio view across many listings and channels
Revenue estimator for prospective acquisitions

use_cases.job: Reprice every listing daily against local demand instead of setting and forgetting
Check what comparable short-term rentals in a neighbourhood actually earn before buying

capabilities: Demand forecasting and dynamic rate setting

tools.name: Smily
tools.positioning: A European-built vacation rental platform where the direct booking website is treated as the point, not an afterthought.
tools.description: Smily, previously BookingSync, provides short-term rental management: channel management across major platforms, a direct booking website, unified inbox and guest messaging, payments, owner reporting and an open API with a developer ecosystem.
tools.real_estate_use: European managers face commission rates that make direct booking the difference between a viable business and a marginal one. Smily's emphasis on the owned website and its own booking engine is aimed at that: channels fill the calendar, but the objective is to move repeat guests onto a direct channel where no commission is paid.
features: Channel management across major booking platforms
Direct booking website with its own booking engine
Unified guest inbox and automated messaging
Payment processing and rental agreements
Owner reporting and statements
Open API and application ecosystem

use_cases.job: Move repeat guests from commissioned channels onto a direct booking site
Manage seasonal rentals with European legal and payment requirements

tools.name: SuperHote
tools.positioning: All-in-one autopilot platform for French short-term rental hosts and conciergeries: unified inbox, AI assistants, guest self-service portal and 1000+ integrations.
tools.description: SuperHote is a French all-in-one platform for short-term rental hosts and conciergerie companies. It unifies guest messaging across Airbnb, Booking, email, SMS and WhatsApp with AI-assisted replies and automatic translation into six languages, gives each guest a self-service portal, and connects to pricing, smart-lock and payment tools plus 1000+ third-party apps through Make and Zapier.
tools.real_estate_use: A host or conciergerie managing several short-term rental properties juggles messages across multiple booking platforms, access codes, contracts and upsells for every stay. SuperHote consolidates that into one inbox with AI-assisted, auto-translated replies, hands the guest a self-service page for check-in codes, contract signature, ID collection and extras, and keeps pricing and smart locks in sync — replacing a stack of spreadsheets and separate apps with one operating system for the rental.
features: Unified multi-channel inbox (Airbnb, Booking, email, SMS, WhatsApp) with AI-assisted replies and auto-translation in six languages
Guest self-service portal: booking, check-in/out, house guide, extras, payment and contract signature
Automatic identity document collection and electronic contract signature
Dynamic pricing sync via PriceLabs
Smart-lock integrations (Igloohome, Nuki)
1000+ third-party app connections via Make and Zapier

use_cases.job: Run guest messaging, check-in, contracts and upsells for a multi-property short-term rental portfolio from one inbox
Automate guest communication and administrative tasks for a self-managed short-term rental

capabilities: Automates guest messaging, pricing adjustments and administrative tasks through five branded AI assistants
